name: ColorSlider
summary: Change one channel of a colour, such as hue, opacity or red, on a track that shows the channel as a gradient. The value is read with a name (214°, Blue; 214 درجة، أزرق) and digits stay Western. The drag has a path without it: arrow keys, Page keys, Home and End, and a press on the track. On web a capsule track with a round thumb; on ios the colour panel's opacity and channel sliders, a tall capsule with a ringed thumb; on android the same form, as Material has no colour slider.
useWhen: Changing the hue, the opacity or one channel of a colour
The sliders view and the opacity row of a colour picker (ColorPicker, order M9.20)
avoidWhen: A number that is not part of a colour
Picking from a few named colours

channel.description: The channel the slider changes. alpha is opacity. Required.

value.description: The colour, controlled: hex, rgb(), hsl() or hsb(), or a React Aria Color. Pass the Color from onChange back to keep the hue of a grey.

onChange.description: Called as the value changes, with the colour as a string in its colour space and as a Color.

onChangeEnd.description: Called when a drag or a key press ends.

colorSpace.description: The colour space of the channel. Default the space of the value.

label.description: The visible name. Default the channel's name: Hue, Opacity, درجة اللون, العتامة.

hideLabel.description: Hides the label row; the slider is then named by aria-label or the channel's name.

showValue.description: Shows the value at the inline end of the label row.

size.description: The track: size.icon.md, size.control.xs or size.control.sm tall. The thumb is as tall and never under 24px.

name.description: The name of the hidden input in a form.

locale.description: The locale of the words and the direction. Default the language of the nearest Theme. Digits stay Western through -u-nu-latn.

a11y.role: group (the track) holding a visually hidden input type range, from React Aria, named by the label. aria-valuetext is the number and a name in the page's words.
a11y.focus: One Tab stop: the thumb's hidden input. The focus ring (focus.shadow.ring) draws around the thumb.

keys.ArrowRight: One step up; one step down in right to left, where the gradient runs from the right
keys.ArrowLeft: One step down; one step up in right to left
keys.Home: The lowest value of the channel
keys.End: The highest value of the channel
keys.Pointer: Drag the thumb, or press anywhere on the track to move the thumb there. The keys and a press are the paths that need no drag (WCAG 2.2 2.5.7).

a11y.announce: Hue, slider, 214°, Blue. Opacity, slider, 50%. Arabic: درجة اللون، 214 درجة، أزرق.
notes: React Aria adds its own colour name to the value text; in Arabic it keeps the English word order (ساطع أزرق سماوي) and a Latin comma, so the value text is replaced after each render with the number and colorName from @the-system/shared.
Digits stay Western: React Aria runs with an -u-nu-latn locale, so the value reads 214 درجة and 50٪ is 50%, never Arabic Indic digits.
WCAG 2.2 1.4.11: the track and the thumb have an edge in color.border.control, 3:1 or more; the thumb has a ring of the surface colour so it shows on any part of the gradient.
WCAG 2.2 2.5.8: the thumb is at least 24 by 24.
Under forced colors the gradient keeps its colours (forced-color-adjust none), edges are CanvasText and focus is a Highlight outline.

en.label: The channel as a noun: Hue, Opacity, Red. Sentence case.

ar.label: اسم القناة بدون تشكيل: درجة اللون، العتامة، الأحمر.

react.behavior: React Aria ColorSlider, SliderTrack, SliderOutput, Label and ColorThumb (react-aria-components) through their render props; words and names from packages/shared/src/color.ts
react.note: Motion: while dragged the thumb grows to scale.stretch on the scale property and settles on release, on duration.base. Reduced motion: no growth in time, as every duration token is 0ms.

angular.note: New wave 2: div[dsColorSlider] with the same DOM, on the CDK or Angular Aria slider, with the gradient from the same channel math.

native.note: Phase R5 draws it: a gradient track and a thumb on Reanimated with accessibilityRole adjustable and the increment and decrement actions.

styles.web: The label and the value over a 24px capsule of the gradient, a round thumb with a surface ring.
styles.ios: The colour panel's slider: a tall capsule (the control sizes grow it), the thumb as tall with a white ring, the label in small capitals above. Content, so solid.
styles.android: The same form at the Android control sizes.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; the thumb may take glass in a later look order, the track stays solid.

mistakes.wrong: A colour slider alone for an exact colour
mistakes.right: Put a ColorField beside it for typing

mistakes.wrong: Passing the hex string back on every change of the hue of a grey
mistakes.right: Pass the Color from onChange back, so the hue is kept
